palette: deep bronze-green field, ivory ding-tablet slips, aged brass, patina teal, seal red, ink charcoal
typography: atrium headings on bronze rail tabs, seal-red verdicts and brass condition plates
composition: a guarantee-system bench with five-type racks, a counter-guarantee invalidity gate with compensation dials, a subordination change board, and a joint-guarantee hall with concurrence lanes
surface: ivory ding-tablet slips on a deep bronze-green field with brass rail posts
motion: type racks post onto the bench, invalidity dials settle at one-half and one-third marks, change boards slide debt tags across gates and joint lanes fork into concurrence and recourse trays
transition: the bronze-green field, brass posts and tablet slips persist while benches, gates, boards and halls are re-dressed between scenes
